quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
You can only turn from certain lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. It reserves the lane for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
The road has curves or turns ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. When it rains, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and stay farther away from the car in front of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means an action is prohibited. This sign means U-turns are not permitted at this location.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intent to other drivers. When your left arm is bent at the elbow with your hand pointing up, it means you are turning right or moving right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two one-way sections with a median between them. You must stay on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and give other traffic the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give other traffic the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first. You do not always have to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may be crossing the road. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is bent downward at the elbow, it means they are about to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed when conditions are good.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed when conditions are good.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road under good conditions. You may need to drive slower if weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green on the bottom. When lights are side by side, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge allows one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the upcoming bridge is narrow. Be careful and do not try to pass a truck on it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is divided by a median or barrier. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light and watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and shows the safe speed to drive (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means that action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black marks on yellow background. This sign warns you that wet roads are slippery and your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What is the main danger when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned if one side of your car sits higher than the other.
You may damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You may lose control if a wheel drops onto the low shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if a wheel drops onto the low shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops off, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a winding road with three or more curves is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a stop sign is ahead. Prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic. Wait for the intersection to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for a highway exit (in this example, 30 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that turning right is not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a crossroad is coming up. Stay alert for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending ahead. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, it signals the group to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot park in this location.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let other vehicles and pedestrians pass safely, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This warning sign tells drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings.

questions.question: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a person is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill road is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with their palm down and swings their arm down to their side, riders following should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From the indicated lane, you must either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane on a multi-lane road will end. Traffic in the right lane must merge left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic signal is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It warns that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with their palm up and swings their arm upward, riders should increase their speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive when turning onto a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or unsafe conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer may cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign warns about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs warn you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians pass. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are likely present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. Slow down and drive carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the area ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and shaped like diamonds. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when turn signals are not available. An arm extended straight out to the left means the rider is turning left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and shaped like diamonds. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is especially slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to hazards on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway curves only to the right.
The highway turns sharply to the right.
The highway curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road ahead curves right first, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and check for traffic before proceeding. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What type of sign is this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to show no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic and turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When a lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger, the group should move into a single-file formation.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns about a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely turn through these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road intersects with a divided highway ahead.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road intersects with a divided highway ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road will cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May continue through or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through.
Must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane does not continue. It becomes an exit ramp. You must change lanes to stay on the freeway, or you will exit. If you stay in this lane, you must exit.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. You should:

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When you see merging traffic, make room for entering vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with traffic lights to tell drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right of way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are arranged from bottom to top as green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you there is a sharp turn ahead and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
Detour right due to roadwork ahead.
Slow down—the road ahead makes a sharp angle turn.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down—the road ahead makes a sharp angle turn.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead has a sharp curve. You should slow down before reaching the curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. If you see this sign, turn around and use a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital emergency room is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Pay attention for pedestrians at intersections and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross at this location. Drive carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait until it is safe to proceed.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Extend your left arm straight out to the left to signal a left turn or lane change to the left. You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a sharp curve ahead in the direction of the arrow. Slow down and follow the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It means you cannot turn right at this location. You must obey all regulatory signs.
